description: This file contains test case classes and utility functions for unit testing, including extensions for exception handling, test invocation management, and leak detection on macOS/iOS platforms.

classes.name: NSException (GTMSenTestPrivateAdditions)
classes.description: Category adding a private method for failure reporting in test files.

classes.name: NSException (GTMSenTestAdditions)
classes.description: Category adding various failure assertion methods for test cases.

classes.name: SenTestCase
classes.description: Base class for test cases with methods for execution, failure reporting, and test invocation collection.

classes.name: GTMTestCase
classes.description: Subclass of SenTestCase adding custom invokeTest with leak detection and logging.

methods.name: failureInFile:atLine:reason:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating a test failure at a specific file and line with a reason.

methods.name: failureInFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException with a formatted description for a failure at a specific file and line.

methods.name: failureInCondition:isTrue:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating a condition failure.

methods.name: failureInEqualityBetweenObject:andObject:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException for object equality failure.

methods.name: failureInEqualityBetweenValue:andValue:withAccuracy:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException for value equality failure with optional accuracy.

methods.name: failureInRaise:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating an expected exception was not raised.

methods.name: failureInRaise:exception:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating an exception was expected to be raised.

methods.name: testCaseWithInvocation:
methods.description: Creates a test case instance with a specific invocation.

methods.name: invokeTest
methods.description: Overrides the test invocation to include leak detection and logging.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the test case.

methods.name: testInvocations
methods.description: Collects all test method invocations, including inherited ones.

methods.name: printException:fromTestName:
methods.description: Logs exception details to stderr with test context.
